label: Bible Study
prompt: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is _____, and in him is no darkness at all.
verse: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
note: John's message in one line — God is light, with no shadows at all.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: So shall thy _____ be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
verse: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
note: Honor God with your firstfruits, and your barns fill with plenty and your presses overflow.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then said the LORD unto Moses, Behold, I will _____ bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.
verse: Then said the LORD unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.
note: God promises to 'rain bread from heaven' — the first announcement of manna.

label: Deep Water
prompt: (For the weapons of our warfare are not _____, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
verse: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
note: Paul's weapons aren't made of flesh — but they're strong enough to pull down fortresses.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The officers answered, Never man _____ like this man.
verse: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.
note: Temple officers sent to arrest Jesus came back empty-handed with this excuse: 'Never man spake like this man.'
